title: Padded list distinctness gives an exponent-one lane endpoint

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Padded list distinctness. For n<4 reject. Otherwise choose the largest w>=1 with m_w=2*w*2^w<=n, split the first m_w bits into 2^w ordered records of 2w bits, and accept exactly if these records are pairwise distinct. Ignore the remaining bits.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"}},"projection":{"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"lane_endpoint"},"theorem":"For this one fixed P language and all sufficiently large actual bit lengths n, C_B2(f_n)>=n*log2(log2(n)), hence the declared polynomial-log lower bound holds and C_B2(f_n)/n tends to positive infinity.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
